name: Incubus Family
source: Marty (or girl version – Maggie) is an unemployed loser stuck at home doing chores for his family. But on his 18th birthday, he gets a surprise visitor: a succubus named Cindy who explains that Marty actually an incubus! Cindy offers to teach Marty the basics of sex demon magic by helping him enslave his sisters Sarah and Rebecca (or boy versions – Seth and Robby). What follows is a perverted journey of sexual self discovery for all involved.
translation: 马蒂（可选女性版本——玛吉）是个待业在家的废柴，成天只能留在家里给家人干杂活。然而在他18岁生日当天，一位名叫辛迪的魅魔不期而至，并向他揭晓了惊人真相——马蒂其实是一名男魅魔！辛迪主动提出传授马蒂色欲魔族魔法的入门技巧，帮他将姐姐妹妹莎拉与丽贝卡（或男性版本——塞思与罗比）收服为奴。一场令所有人深陷其中的背德情欲自我探索之旅就此拉开帷幕。
